newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Feed to seek 35,000T corn, 15,000T barley.
newsitem.headline: Korea Feed to seek 35,000T corn, 15,000T barley.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) will seek to buy 35,000 tonnes of feed corn and 15,000 tonnes of feed barley this week, traders said on Monday.
Traders said the KFA would invite the tenders by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday.
If feed barley prices are lower than that of corn, traders said the KFA would probably buy up to 50,000 tonnes of feed barley instead.
Deliveries of the feed barley and feed corn were set for December 5 to the western port of Inchon.
